findings.failure_path: C4’s 'never looser' rationale does not follow from the stated one-conclusive-result rule. A stale local base can include an older, already-landed review result that CI’s current PR-base diff excludes. A new skill change without current evidence could therefore pass locally and fail CI under the described selection rule. The omitted checker and CI revision-selection logic provide no evidence excluding this counterexample or establishing merge-head parity.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove the monotonicity claim and keep C4 open until checker/CI revision and result-selection logic, plus stale-base and merge-head parity evidence, are supplied.
